compoundProgramDisplayNames: KB Lateral Clean or Outside Swing to Rack

exercises.purpose: Low-fatigue hip rotation and position work used to restore or prepare squat and hinge positions without creating meaningful training fatigue.
coachingCues: Set both hips comfortably before chasing range.
Move through the hips rather than twisting through the low back.
Keep the torso controlled and breathe through the position.
Use a pain-free range and let repeated clean reps improve motion.
commonMistakes: Rolling through the low back to create motion.
Turning recovery mobility into a hard stretch.
exercises.evidenceBasis: LetMeFly v7 RT-027 Hip / Lower-Body Mobility Reset + v12 Exercise Demo Library distinct 90/90 Hip Mobility identity

exercises.purpose: Develop crisp low-volume vertical lower-body power while rehearsing controlled takeoff and landing quality with low fatigue.
coachingCues: Start each rep from a stable athletic position.
Jump with maximal intent but keep the dose low.
Land quietly with hips, knees and ankles sharing the load.
Stand tall on the box before stepping down and resetting.
commonMistakes: Choosing a box height that forces excessive knee tuck or poor landing position.
exercises.evidenceBasis: Stage4F EX-009 / v1.9 Exercise Intelligence Box Jump + Black Crown primer role + v7 RT-029

exercises.purpose: A squat-pattern strength tool that develops knee/quad capacity, bracing and position quality while using the box as a controlled depth and positional reference.
coachingCues: Brace before the descent and keep a full-foot tripod.
Control the descent to the box instead of dropping onto it.
Keep tension through the trunk and legs on contact.
Drive hips and chest up together without rocking for momentum.
commonMistakes: Letting the knees collapse or hips shoot up first.
exercises.evidenceBasis: Black Crown squat-pattern governance + Stage4H source map / v1.9 Auto Selection Output

exercises.purpose: Develop low-volume horizontal projection and explosiveness while preserving controlled landing quality.
coachingCues: Load the hips and swing the arms with intent.
Project forward rather than only upward.
Land softly with the whole foot and absorb through hips and knees.
Stick the landing before resetting the next rep.
commonMistakes: Falling or stepping through every landing.
Chasing distance after landing quality drops.
exercises.evidenceBasis: Stage4F EX-009 Box Jump / Broad Jump role + v1.9 Exercise Intelligence

exercises.purpose: Train explosive horizontal pressing as a low-volume upper-body power primer without turning the slot into fatigue-focused push-up volume.
coachingCues: Set a rigid plank before each rep.
Lower under control and reverse with maximal intent.
Project the hands from the floor while keeping the trunk connected.
Reset fully between reps when needed to preserve speed.
commonMistakes: Chasing high reps after speed drops.
Using a range or hand position that irritates wrists or shoulders.
exercises.evidenceBasis: Stage4F EX-011 + Stage4H source map + Black Crown primer role

exercises.purpose: Low-load finger-extensor and hand-health work that balances gripping stress without becoming another fatiguing grip exercise.
coachingCues: Use a light band and spread the fingers under control.
Keep the wrist neutral and the forearm relaxed.
Open fully without forcing the joints.
Stop well before hand fatigue affects higher-priority pulling or carries.
commonMistakes: Snapping the fingers open and closed.
Turning the drill into a high-fatigue finisher.
Adding volume when the hands are already taxed.
exercises.evidenceBasis: LetMeFly v7 RT-037 Hand / Wrist Health + Black Crown grip governance + v12 Finger Extension Band identity

exercises.purpose: Train controlled hip rotation and single-leg pelvic stability with low fatigue as preparation for squat, hinge and athletic work.
coachingCues: Own a stable single-leg hinge position first.
Rotate from the hip while keeping the stance foot rooted.
Move slowly and keep the pelvis controlled.
Use support when needed to preserve clean hip motion.
commonMistakes: Choosing unsupported reps when balance prevents hip control.
exercises.evidenceBasis: Black Crown warm-up programming + v12 plan-approved Hip Airplane -> Supported Hip Airplane relationship

exercises.purpose: Develop crisp ballistic hip extension while resetting the bell between reps or short clusters to reduce cyclic density and reinforce a clean hinge start.
coachingCues: Set the bell and brace before each dead-start.
Hike from a stable hinge and keep the lats connected.
Snap the hips and let the bell float.
Return the bell under control and fully reset before the next start.
commonMistakes: Yanking the bell with the arms.
Hyperextending the low back at lockout.
exercises.evidenceBasis: Black Crown primer/power programming + v12 Exercise Demo Library KB Dead-Stop Swing identity

exercises.purpose: Develop explosive horizontal pressing with very low eccentric cost as a crisp upper-body power primer.
coachingCues: Start braced with the ball at the chest.
Drive the pass as fast as possible without a slow grinding push.
Keep the trunk connected and finish through the hands.
Reset completely between throws so every rep is explosive.
commonMistakes: Using a ball too heavy to move fast.
Catching or rebounding in a way that adds unnecessary shoulder stress.
exercises.evidenceBasis: Stage4F EX-010 / v1.9 Medicine-Ball Chest Pass + Black Crown primer role

exercises.purpose: A partial-range heavy hinge/pull tool used to develop posterior-chain strength, pulling skill, bracing and back/hip durability at a governed rack height.
coachingCues: Set the rack height exactly as programmed.
Brace hard and take the slack out before the pull.
Keep the bar close and drive through the floor while extending the hips.
Finish tall without leaning back or hitching.
commonMistakes: Changing rack height to chase load.
Jerking the bar from the pins.
exercises.evidenceBasis: Crownforge live pull/hinge programming + Black Crown hinge/pull anchor-pattern governance

exercises.purpose: Single-leg lower-body support that builds quad/glute strength, pelvic control and useful unilateral volume without replacing the primary squat pattern.
coachingCues: Step back far enough to keep the front foot stable.
Stay stacked over the working leg.
Lower under control with the front knee tracking over the foot.
Drive through the front leg to return without pushing excessively off the rear foot.
commonMistakes: Stepping too narrow and losing balance.
Pushing mainly from the rear leg.
Using load that turns clean single-leg work into a wobbling grind.
exercises.evidenceBasis: v1.9 Stage4H source map / Auto Selection Output + Black Crown structural-support programming

exercises.purpose: A wide-grip Romanian-deadlift variation used for posterior-chain strength and hinge tolerance while increasing upper-back and lat positional demand.
coachingCues: Set the snatch-width grip before bracing.
Keep a soft knee and push the hips back.
Keep the bar close and the upper back connected.
Stop when hamstring tension or position limits the range; stand with the glutes.
commonMistakes: Choosing a grip so wide that shoulder position breaks down.
Chasing depth by rounding the back.
exercises.evidenceBasis: Black Crown hinge/pull anchor-pattern governance + active Black Crown Snatch-Grip RDL secondary slot

exercises.purpose: Isometric posterior-chain and spinal-endurance work used for low-back durability and trunk stiffness without adding another loaded hinge.
coachingCues: Set the pelvis securely on the support.
Hold a long neutral line from head through hips.
Brace and breathe without losing trunk position.
End the hold when posture changes rather than extending the clock.
commonMistakes: Chasing time after posture has already failed.
exercises.evidenceBasis: Black Crown back-extension role governance + active conditional low-back-durability slot

exercises.purpose: Low-load lower-trapezius and scapular-control work that supports yoke/upper-back development without adding heavy shrug or grip stress.
coachingCues: Set the torso and keep the neck relaxed.
Reach the arm in the intended Y/scapular plane rather than straight out to the side.
Move the shoulder blade smoothly without shrugging toward the ear.
Use light load and pause in the controlled top position.
commonMistakes: Turning the movement into an upper-trap shrug.
Using momentum or excessive dumbbell load.
Losing scapular control to chase range.
exercises.evidenceBasis: Black Crown yoke/trap emphasis governance + active Trap-3 Raise yoke/carry slot
